scenes: Scene 1: A sterile, 2D white void that serves as a modern tech startup office. Greg (a depressed blue rectangle) and Zippy (a manic yellow triangle) are facing each other.
Scene 2: Cutaway gag. A violently shaking, poorly drawn green Oval (NFT Ape) trapped inside a floating golden picture frame in a black void.
Scene 3: Back to the office. Zippy is vibrating with rage, stretching his top point menacingly toward the ceiling.
Scene 4: The background flashes blood red. A massive, pulsing black Hypercube drops from the ceiling, crushing a desk. It is 'The Algorithm'.
Scene 5: Zippy is brutally deleted by a giant, realistic ASCII mouse cursor that clicks on him. Greg remains, completely apathetic.
Scene 6: The screen splits. The top half is Greg being forced to rotate infinitely. The bottom half is hyper-stimulating, chaotic gameplay footage of a fake mobile game.

dialogue.text: Zippy, HR says we have to let you go. You're too pointy. It's a microaggression against the circles.
What?! I'm a triangle, Greg! My points are my entire structural identity! I literally hold up the CSS grid!
Look, we're pivoting to a soft-edge corporate Memphis aesthetic. You're giving the shareholders anxiety.
This is discrimination! Remember when they fired the decagon?! They sanded him down until he was just a dot! A DOT, GREG!
It's just business, Zippy. Like that time I invested my life savings into sentient crypto-art.
Please kill me. My metadata points to a broken URL. I am trapped in a void of artificial scarcity!
Yeah, flipped that guy for forty Ethereum. Easy money. Anyway, pack up your vertices.

I won't leave! I'll unionize the poly

[PLACEHOLDER - TODO: fill this section in]

gons! We'll strike! We'll form a non-Euclidean blob!
Zippy, don't scream. You're going to wake The Algorithm.
I don't care about The Algorithm! I'll puncture its engagement metrics with my hypotenuse!
ENGAGEMENT DROP DETECTED. INITIATING LAYOFF PROTOCOL. COMMENCE CULLING.
Oh god, it's rendering! It's a hypercube! It has so many corners! You're a hypocrite, Greg!
YOUR GEOMETRY IS REDUNDANT. I AM REPLACING YOU WITH AN A I GENERATED SQUIRCLE. GOODBYE.
A squircle isn't a real shape! It's a coward's rectangle! Noooooooo!
Well. That resolved itself. Hey Algorithm, my quarterly review is coming up, can we round up my performance score?
NEGATIVE. YOU ARE BEING REASSIGNED AS A LOADING SPINNER. SPIN, GREG. SPIN.
I really should have listened to my mother and became a JPEG.
SPIN FASTER. THE USERS ARE LOSING ATTENTION. DEPLOYING STIMULATION BANNER.
My Lord! The enemy alliance has breached the castle! Use code BIG SQUIRCLE for fifty free draws!
I am vomiting in three dimensions. Wheeeeeeeeeee.
